messages:
Maya: Quick check — do we have a concise plan for protocol/versioning for quota tokens at the edge? Seeing mismatches between ingress and central quota svc after the header change.
Raj: I noticed that on the canary — ingress sends X-Quota-Meta now and central still expects X-Quota-Token shape v1. Fails as a 400 in a subset of requests.
Lin: Can you paste the two wire examples? helps to be explicit.
Maya: Sure:
```
# v1
X-Quota-Token: eyJ0IjoiMTIzIiwicmQiOjEwMDB9
# v2 (current canary)
X-Quota-Token: eyJ2IjoiMiIsInRfaWQiOiIxMjMiLCJzIjoicmQifQ==
X-Quota-Version: 2
```
Priya: OK — two obvious approaches: (A) add explicit version header and have central accept v1+v2 (detect by header or payload), (B) keep backward payload compatibility by embedding a union shape — but that requires changing token encoding at ingress.
Sam: Tradeoffs: (A) is lower risk for rollout but requires every consumer to honor X-Quota-Version header; proxies need to keep forwarding it. (B) is better long-term but needs coordinated rollout across all edge proxies and any SDKs that emit tokens.
Raj: Also need to consider abuse surface. If we accept both formats we must ensure signature verification and TTL checks remain consistent. v2 added a `sid` field which we started using for session-scoped quotas.
Priya: Suggestion: implement a short-term compatibility layer in central: accept both payload shapes, prefer explicit header if present, and run transform path to normalize to internal v2 canonical representation. Add telemetry flags when central hits a v1 token.
Lin: +1. That lets us roll proxies gradually. Monitoring signals to add: percent v1 vs v2, failure rate by token type, latency delta when transform path used, and any auth/signature mismatches.
Maya: For rollout plan I'd propose:
1) Central: deploy compatibility handler behind a feature flag that logs v1 hits (1 day)
2) Edge canaries: start emitting X-Quota-Version:2 and new token shape (2 days)
3) Gradual traffic ramp (50% -> 100% over 1 week)
4) After 2 weeks with <0.1% error and no abuse signals, flip to canonical v2-only acceptance and deprecate v1 (announce 30d)
Sam: How do we make central reject v1 safely? We should have a fallback policy that if traffic starts hitting v1 spikes, we auto-fallback to compatibility for a short window (circuit breaker).
Raj: Agree. Implement an admission circuit: if v1 failures > threshold OR auth failures > threshold, enable compatibility for X minutes and page.
Priya: For proxies rollout, require small invariant: proxy must forward X-Quota-Version when present and preserve token encoding. Add unit tests for middleware. Also update SDKs that mint tokens.
Lin: About abuse detection: v2 includes `sid` so we can track session churn. We should add rate-limit heuristics keyed by (tenant, sid) and a guard for high token churn that might indicate token-stuffing attacks.
Maya: Good point. Also tighten TTL for v1-issued tokens as part of deprecation: have central treat v1 tokens with 1/2 TTL to reduce abuse window.
Sam: Can we avoid double decode overhead? Central transform path will decode token, re-encode internal struct. That's an extra CPU op -> measure baseline and include in SLO risk doc.
Priya: Add a short perf test: synthetic through canary with transform on vs off, measure p95 CPU and latency. Put it in perf-suite.
edge-bot: deploy edge-proxy/canary v2 token-emitter succeeded for cluster us-west-2 :white_check_mark:
Raj: Nice. Can we add a quick lint rule in ingress repo to warn if X-Quota-Version is not set when emitting a token?
Maya: Yes — PR incoming from me tomorrow.
Lin: I'll add the central feature-flag toggle and the telemetry counters (quota.token_version) — will instrument percent-v1, auth-failures-by-version, transform-latency.
Sam: I'll own the rollout runbook and circuit-breaker thresholds. Pls tag me in canary metrics.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the short RFC addendum to document the version negotiation semantics and migration timeline, then post to eng-infra for signoff. :thumbsup:
Priya: Acked.
Sam: LGTM.
Raj: Thx.
Maya: (closing) I'll update the SDK issue tracker with migration checklist.
thread_summary: compatibility plan for quota token wire-versioning between edge proxies and central quota service, migration steps, telemetry + abuse mitigation
